integrity: The formula is derived by counting exact initial white configurations. One self-review and reproducible graph-level checks are supplied. Independent review or publication-priority certification is not represented as performed.
limitations: Only Cartesian matched cliques K_n square K_2 with n>=2; not general rook graphs.
Standard zero forcing and minimal forts; not skew or positive semidefinite forcing.
The limiting random-initial-color theorem assumes independent identically distributed colors.
Exhaustive graph-level checks cover n<=8 for zero forcing and n<=7 for forts; the infinite proof is combinatorial.
Published-priority originality is a best-knowledge comparison and has not been independently certified.
title: Complete zero-forcing and minimal-fort distributions for matched pairs of cliques
